biography.plain_text: Steven Lee Rosenberg, known as Lee, is an American businessman who led Philadelphia's Victor/Sacks Furs, a manufacturer, wholesaler and retailer of fur and leather clothing. Trained in marketing and advertising at the University of Findlay, he also served as president and later chairman of the Master Furriers' Guild of America.

long_biography.plain_text:
Lee Rosenberg sold his Philadelphia clothing business when his wife, Chris Davis, took a senior role at Gulfstream Aerospace. The family moved to Hilton Head so she could work at the aircraft manufacturer's Savannah headquarters. The decision ended his long period running Victor/Sacks and supported the next stage of her career.

In retirement, Rosenberg has devoted time to marine research and education through ANGARI Foundation, working alongside his daughters Angela and Kari. He has participated in scientific tagging projects and supported deployments of oceanographic instruments. His community work also includes mentoring young men through Big Brothers of America.
